about: Single source of the card layout (DECISIONS #120) and of the allow-list of persistent write paths (DECISIONS #121). Read by os/tools/image_check.py, os/tools/size_plan.py, tests/os/test_persistence_layout.py and tests/unit/test_persistence_allowlist.py; explained in docs/PERSISTENCE.md. Sizes in MiB (2^20 bytes) unless the key says bytes.

card_target.why: a nominal 2 GB card has 2*10^9 bytes on the label; real cards report less (typically 1.9-1.98*10^9). 10 % below the label is the conservative usable size the whole image must fit in.

data_budget.largest_bundle_why: a completely full 384 MiB slot compressed 2:1 (measured: the 74 MiB development bundle holds a rootfs with 185 MiB in use, 2.5:1). RAUC streaming is off, so the whole bundle is stored on /data while it is verified and installed.
data_budget.space_margin_why: btbridge.ota.transfer.SPACE_MARGIN: the update manager refuses an upload/download unless this much stays free after it
data_budget.state_why: settings, secrets, network, certificates, journals, two pre-update snapshots, update state, RAUC status, Bluetooth bonds of ~100 phones, clock file (measured: well below 1 MiB on a set-up lab device)

persistent.content: owner settings and secrets, network configuration, device certificates and keys, setup code, journals, update state and staging
persistent.why: administrator credentials, device keys, Wi-Fi/network/LMS/MQTT configuration, OTA/rollback state (DECISIONS #121)
persistent.size: < 1 MiB; + one update bundle (<= 192 MiB) only while an update is staged/installed
persistent.frequency: on owner changes, session start/end, updates

persistent.content: adapter settings, bonds (link keys) and device attributes of paired phones, BlueZ name cache
persistent.why: Bluetooth bonds: a paired phone reconnects after a reboot without pairing again

persistent.content: empty file 'clock' whose modification time is the last known time
persistent.why: a Pi has no RTC: after a reboot without network the clock starts at the last known time instead of the build date (TLS validity, certificates)
persistent.frequency: every SaveIntervalSec=900 s and at each NTP synchronisation

persistent.content: RAUC central status (data-directory): per-slot install status, bundle version and hash
persistent.why: OTA/rollback state: which bundle is in which slot
ext4 file system check after a power cut
persistent.frequency: only when e2fsck repairs the file system

bridge_files.about: Every file the bridge may create below /var/lib/hifi-bridge (= /data/hifi-bridge). Glob patterns relative to that directory; anything else is a violation of DECISIONS #121 (tests/unit/test_persistence_allowlist.py).
patterns: owner settings incl. LMS, MQTT, syslog target, device name and labels
a damaged settings file moved aside (defaults are used)
owner password hash, setup code hash, session key, stream token, MQTT password, flash-tool trust key, log salt
a damaged secrets file moved aside
Wi-Fi client, Ethernet/Wi-Fi addresses, setup hotspot, country
a network change on trial (Keep/Undo survives a restart of the bridge)
the one-time setup code until the owner password is set
the LMS item the bridge owns (player + stream URL, no title): released after a crash or power cut
exactly-once processing of the provisioning file across power cuts
exactly-once processing of a recovery request across power cuts
device CA private key (never leaves the card)
empty lock file shared with the health check
which version is in which slot (for the rollback offer)
per update/boot of a new slot
result of the last post-boot health check (mark-good / rollback decision)
an owner-requested snapshot restore for the next start
settings, secrets, network and certificates before an update, per slot
the update bundle (staged / being installed); removed after a successful install, on discard, and at boot when no state needs it
an upload in progress; removed on failure, cancel, and at the next start
a download in progress or paused; removed on discard and at the next boot
URL and size of that download (resume)

boot_fat_writes.owner: U-Boot (boot counter), RAUC via fw_setenv (install, mark-good)
boot_fat_writes.why: A/B boot selection and boot counter (boot/recovery metadata)
boot_fat_writes.frequency: every boot (U-Boot) + every healthy boot (mark-good) + per update

boot_fat_writes.why: power-cut safety of the boot selection
offline status for the owner: name, CA fingerprint, setup code while needed, recovery results
provisioning slot: scrubbed after it was applied (it held secrets)
recovery request placed by the owner: removed once processed

unit_writers.about: The only units allowed to name a persistent location (/data, /boot or one of the bind targets above) in ReadWritePaths= or StateDirectory= (image check persist.unit-write-paths). Every other unit can write RAM only.
